title: Next.js: Cross-client response injection and disclosure in self-hosted Next.js applications forwarding fetched…
description: A vulnerability in self-hosted Next.js applications using App Router route handlers and fetch cache can cause cross-client response injection and disclosure. This occurs when the application returns an upstream fetched response unchanged, leading to mismatched response framing. When deployed behind an HTTP/1.1 reverse proxy that allows pipelined response queueing, crafted upstream responses can desynchronize client responses, enabling injection and disclosure of other clients' data. Fixed versions 16.4.5 and 15.5.29 address this issue.
